summary: Measurability, then the image measure by cases: at the top from theta_spec; below, compare integrals after identifying δ^(b)_F through uniqueness of disintegrations and changing variables.

steps.claim: σ ↦ σ⁻¹f_b is measurable (it is continuous).

steps.lean:
b.lastCases
  (by simp [floorMeasure, theta_spec]) fun a ↦ ext_of_lintegral _ fun Φ _ ↦ by
  rw [← ((isDisintegration_quadricMeasure (IsHermitian.submatrix ‹IsHermUnit _›.1 (·.1))).map _
    ((gram_inclMatrix (![.inl a, eStar a] ⊕ᵥ @Subtype.val _ (a + 1 ≤ floorOf ·)) 1).trans _)).unique
    (F.isDisintegration_floorVolume _ (map_inclMatrix_eq_floorVolume _ _ _))]
  any_goals simp [gram_inclMatrix, ← ext_iff]; grind
  simp (disch := with_unfolding_all fun_prop) [floorMeasure, heisenbergMeasure, lintegral_map,
    mconv, lintegral_prod, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul, volume_eq_prod]
  rw [lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp ae_isUnit]; rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  rw [← lintegral_neg_eq_self, eq_comm, lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map (map_mulVec_volume _
    (t.1 • 1) _), lintegral_map] <;> first | fun_prop | simp [↓card_succ_le_floorOf, orbitPoint,
    heisenbergElem_inv, ← mulVec_mulVec, -mulVec_single]
  congr! 3; rw [lintegral_sub_left_eq_self (Φ <| heisenbergElem a ⟨_, ·⟩ |>.1.1 *ᵥ _)]
  congr!; simp [↓heisenbergElem_mulVec, flatChart, inclMatrix_val_mulVec, -inverse_star_unit,
    floorWeyl, weylOn, level, ← Pi.single_apply, col_apply', ↓splitGram_col, ← gram_inclMatrix]
  simp [funext_iff, inclMatrix, mulVec_apply_eq_sum, ← mulVec_smul, star_mulVec_dotProduct]
  grind [invOf_mul_self, Matrix.mul_assoc]⟩
steps.claim: The image of θ^F_b: split b ∈ {0, …, ϱ} into the top b = ϱ and b = a < ϱ.
b = ϱ: θ^F_ϱ = F.θ, and theta_spec says that its image under σ ↦ σ⁻¹z is floorQuadric(F, ϱ).

steps.claim: b = a < ϱ: it suffices that both measures give every measurable Φ ≥ 0 the same integral.

floorQuadric(F, a) equals the quadric measure of the explicit basis (e_a, e*_a, then the coordinates of floor ≥ a + 1) carried to V: both disintegrate floorVolume(a) along v ↦ h(v, v) (the pushed-forward flat-chart disintegration, and isDisintegration_floorVolume), so they agree by uniqueness.
The side conditions of 2.2.1: the Gram matrix of the explicit basis is that of a hyperbolic plane plus J_T on floor ≥ a + 1, and the inclusion has a left inverse.

steps.lean:
simp (disch := with_unfolding_all fun_prop) [floorMeasure, heisenbergMeasure, lintegral_map,
    mconv, lintegral_prod, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul, volume_eq_prod]
steps.claim: Unfold θ^F_a = weylLaw(a) ∗ η_a: the integral of Φ(σ⁻¹f_a) becomes an iterated integral over c ∈ A with density md(c)^{k+1+2(ϱ−a−1)}, over v ∈ V_{a+1} and over the skew β.
Almost every c is a unit (field ae_isUnit of the place); write c = t ∈ Aˣ.

steps.lean:
rw [← lintegral_neg_eq_self, eq_comm, lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map (map_mulVec_volume _
    (t.1 • 1) _), lintegral_map] <;> first | fun_prop | simp [↓card_succ_le_floorOf, orbitPoint,
    heisenbergElem_inv, ← mulVec_mulVec, -mulVec_single]
steps.claim: Substitute v ↦ t·v in the integral over V_{a+1} (Jacobian md(t)^{k+1+2(ϱ−a−1)}, the rank of V_{a+1} by card_succ_le_floorOf), which cancels the density; express σ⁻¹f_a through ν(v, β)⁻¹ = ν(−v, skewPart(τh(v,v)) − β).
Translate the skew variable β (Haar measure is translation invariant).

steps.lean:
congr!; simp [↓heisenbergElem_mulVec, flatChart, inclMatrix_val_mulVec, -inverse_star_unit,
    floorWeyl, weylOn, level, ← Pi.single_apply, col_apply', ↓splitGram_col, ← gram_inclMatrix]
  simp [funext_iff, inclMatrix, mulVec_apply_eq_sum, ← mulVec_smul, star_mulVec_dotProduct]
  grind [invOf_mul_self, Matrix.mul_assoc]⟩
steps.claim: What remains is the identity of vectors: w_a(t)·ν(v, β)⁻¹ applied to f_a equals the flat-chart point of (t, v, β) in the explicit basis; checked entrywise from the formulas for the Heisenberg element, the floor Weyl element and the flat chart.
